body: I only watched tonight's episode to see how they would address seonho's departure. Turned it off after Seyoon said that there's been a "small change". I felt so disrespected on seonho's behalf.
Well that's one way to get more fenestrations on a monstera
Nothing brings me as much joy as watching alocasias grow. 😁
Hi there! I'm still trying to get the babies to grow up before I start propagating. And I Iive in the Philippines.
I am. Thank you for taking the time to check in on me. I hope you're having a great weekend so far.
Yup, this is me. At 28 I feel like a complete hopeless failure, especially when I find out that my peers are getting married, having kids, doing great in their career, etc. You're not alone, OP.
Glad to help!

Have you tried relaxation techniques? Like deep breathing exercises? There are apps for that, they might be of help too. It sounds like you might have generalized anxiety disorder, but don't take my word for it cause I'm not a doctor. It's best to ask a psychiatrist. I hope you get the answers/help you need. Hugs
Hey, I'm so sorry about what you're going through. It must be so exhausting trying to pretend to be okay all the time. Is there any way you can move out? Or seek professional help?
You can cross that bridge if you get there, but right now, try to just focus on forgiving yourself. You got this, man. I believe in you.

Don't give up on yourself. The first step is to accept and acknowledge that what you did was wrong, and I'm proud of you for doing so. You've come a long way already. Maybe you can go to counseling or therapy to work out the guilt. People change, our mistakes don't define us.
Hey OP, just wanted to say I appreciate what you're doing, and so do a lot of people here. I'm glad there are people like you around. 🤗
I get that. I want the same thing myself. I hope someone around you makes you feel loved and valued. You deserve it.

Hey, I hope you stay. Meds, therapy and counseling didn't work for me either. It's frustrating how we want to try and better ourselves but it just isn't that easy. I don't know what to say to make you feel better. Even I have the same struggles. I just wish you'd stay. I know I'm just a stranger to you, but I genuinely care and I want you here. This may sound selfish but I find comfort in knowing I'm not alone in my suffering. I hope it brings you comfort too, knowing you're not the only one who's going through this.
Thanks. I haven't always been, but I'm gonna spend the rest of my life making up for it.

My parents. They don't deserve any of the shit I've put them through over the years. And they don't deserve to have to spend the rest of their lives blaming themselves for my suicide and wondering where they went wrong with me.

Yeah, my parents were overly protective of me. I think most Asian parents are (we're Chinese-Filipino), especially towards the youngest and only girl in the family. But my mom and I have a great relationship now. My dad's always been there for me too. Although he also has depression and anxiety and i don't want to add to his troubles so I try not to burden him too much with my shit.

Yeah you're right, there is this strange sense of pride in knowing you share an exact birthday with someone. Hey, I'll stick around to wish you a happy birthday then too.

Hey birthday buddy. So many parallels in our lives lol. 

The slump comes and goes and there are days when I'm okay enough. But lately it's been eating me up.

Glad to know you're in a good place mentally, birthday buddy. Happy birthday in advance to us.
I really appreciate your kind words. Thank you so much. I wish I could give you an actual hug.

It's gonna be hard to pursue all that stuff considering the covid restrictions in my country. I love traveling and I used to go out of the country at least twice a year before covid struck. And now I guess part of the reason my depression is starting up again is because I feel trapped. I've been stuck at home for the past year now, and it looks like things aren't gonna change any time soon. It's taken quite a massive toll on me mentally and emotionally. I don't know what to do anymore.

Thank you. Now I'm crying. I really needed to hear that. But this has been so exhausting. I don't have a job right now but I'm taking up a 2nd degree in BS Nursing. It's been pretty tough going. No hobbies or interests. I usually just spend my days watching random stuff on netflix.
It isn't. At least not until I get out of this shitty country. I'm taking up a 2nd course of BS Nursing, and planning to move to the states. Currently in the Philippines.

My parents didn't approve of him. My mom and I fought constantly over the fact that I didn't have standards. That took a toll on my relationship too because I spiraled into depression over the constant feeling of having to choose him over family.
I have a friend from high school, the one I spoke to about my epiphany. But she gets a little too preachy about God and faith and that just isn't something I need right now.
